payload.title: Validating a Reconstruction
payload.summary: This Jupyter notebook aims to validate a paleoclimate reconstruction by comparing it to the original LMRv2.1 reconstruction and multiple instrumental datasets such as HadCRUT5, GISTEMP, and Berkeley Earth. The validation process involves assessing global mean surface temperature (GMST) comparisons, climate field skill metrics, and ensemble similarity using the plume distance framework. The notebook utilizes various Python libraries for data manipulation, visualization, and statistical analysis. Outputs include plots and statistical comparisons that help evaluate the reconstruction's accuracy.
goals: Compare paleoclimate reconstruction to LMRv2.1 and instrumental datasets.
Assess reconstruction quality using GMST comparisons and climate field skill metrics.
Evaluate ensemble similarity using the plume distance framework.
